criterion_verbatim: Perform one-at-a-time and global sensitivity over uncertain thresholds, rates, initial states, and alternative rules.
audited_scope: One-at-a-time and global sensitivity over uncertain initial states.
what_was_tested: An exhaustive enumeration over all 32 cfg-weighted latent assignments for the adhesion arms (v0.4): basal and mifepristone are 0/32 even with the embryo inputs forced true. The E_KLF12_HIGH prior sweep (v0.4), labelled an arbitrary-threshold sensitivity analysis.
current_claim: No latent assignment inverts the ordinal adhesion claim. Untreated and mifepristone are OFF at the fixed point of every weighted latent assignment (computed on v0.5.1). The strict ordering untreated < HT > HT+mifepristone holds only in expectation, because HT is ON in some assignments and not others.
limitation: The relay priors (0.7/0.4/0.2) are hand-set and were never swept. The HT magnitude is a closed-form function of them, 1-(1-p_spp1)(1-p_redundant). The KLF12 sweep is v0.4 and activated nothing.
unblock_requirement: A v0.5.1 exact sweep of the latent priors. It is cheap, but it informs no retained claim, because none is a magnitude.
computed_premises: exact fixed point adoc-literature-superset-v0.5.1: untreated 0, HT 0.82, HT+mifepristone 0; ordinal claim holds = True
